hypotheses.AA0_full_head_program_is_exact: All 144 edges match direct gradients at every evaluation site with cosine at least 0.999 and relative error at most 0.02.
hypotheses.AA1_top64_sets_are_stable: Independent discovery top-64 sets have Jaccard overlap at least 0.40, above the approximately 0.286 random-set expectation.
hypotheses.AA2_full_rankings_are_correlated: The two complete edge rankings have Spearman correlation at least 0.50.
hypotheses.AA3_rediscovered_top64_transfers: The independently rediscovered top-64 program reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 at every distance.
hypotheses.AA4_two_top64_programs_are_behaviorally_: Their median gradient cosines differ by at most 0.05 at every distance.
hypotheses.AA5_intersection_is_useful: The literal intersection of the two top-64 sets reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.80 at every distance.
hypotheses.AA6_both_top64_programs_beat_random: Both frozen programs exceed matched-random p95 median cosine by at least 0.15 at every distance.
hypotheses.AA7_all_selection_is_disjoint: Both rankings are frozen before the third-panel evaluation and no evaluation outcome affects either set.
